INSERT INTO property_safety ( property_id, destination_id, safety_score, cctv_count, street_lamp_count, has_police_station ) VALUES ( #{propertyId}, #{destinationId}, #{safetyScore}, #{cctvCount}, #{streetLampCount}, #{hasPoliceStation} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE safety_score = VALUES(safety_score), cctv_count = VALUES(cctv_count), street_lamp_count = VALUES(street_lamp_count), has_police_station = VALUES(has_police_station), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT property_id AS propertyId, destination_id AS destinationId, route_id AS routeId, search_option AS searchOption, route_type AS routeType, distance_meters AS distanceMeters, total_time_seconds AS totalTimeSeconds, CAST(route_points AS CHAR) AS routePointsJson, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM property_safety_route WHERE property_id = #{propertyId} AND destination_id = #{destinationId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_safety_route ( property_id, destination_id, route_id, search_option, route_type, distance_meters, total_time_seconds, route_points ) VALUES ( #{propertyId}, #{destinationId}, #{routeId}, #{searchOption}, #{routeType}, #{distanceMeters}, #{totalTimeSeconds}, CAST(#{routePointsJson} AS JSON) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE route_id = VALUES(route_id), search_option = VALUES(search_option), route_type = VALUES(route_type), distance_meters = VALUES(distance_meters), total_time_seconds = VALUES(total_time_seconds), route_points = VALUES(route_points), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
